name: Fire Lights (GI Simulation)
definition: When Global Illumination (GI) is used, fire illuminates scene objects and Simulator's own Smoke automatically, but rendering is slower. Create Fire Lights simulates GI by placing light sources in bright parts of the fire, giving similar results and rendering much faster. Color and power adjusted automatically but can be overridden.
summary: Fire Lights simulates global illumination by placing light sources in bright fire regions, offering a faster alternative to full GI calculations.
